task.title: Review private Sunday decision packet review deck
task.body:

- Confirm the artifact clearly separates internal review from approval/execution; it must not imply approval capture, public readiness, live HighLevel/Supabase/CRM/Clio authority, source-current prospecting, sends, posts, workflow actions, or public launch.
- Confirm blocker lineage `t_fa6eb9c1` (Supabase expanded-schema DDL) and `t_53d470c6` (gated backfill/sync) are visible and correctly constrained.

Business-development principle to preserve: deliver narrow diagnostic value first, make the buyer problem-aware, earn engaged time/trust before any consultation ask, and keep all follow-up opt-in-only; Whiteford/Schell IP legal copy must remain educational, non-hypey, non-confidential, attorney-review-gated, and no-ACR/no-legal-advice.

Deliverables expected:
- Write `/Users/jeff/Documents/Codex/2026-05-05/i-want-to-install-hermes-agent/whiteford-ai-law-pages/docs/reviews/2026-05-10_sunday_decision_review_deck_review.md` with PASS / NEEDS REVISION verdict for internal Jeff/Whiteford decision prep only.
- Update `/Users/jeff/Documents/Codex/2026-05-05/i-want-to-install-hermes-agent/whiteford-ai-law-pages/docs/KANBAN_DELIVERABLE_INDEX.md`.
- Leave the standard Kanban deliverable comment.

Acceptance criteria:
- If PASS: list exact remaining Jeff/manual approvals and confirm all external/live-system actions are withheld.
- If NEEDS REVISION: name exact file/section/copy changes needed and create/leave a narrow follow-up recommendation.
- No external/public action, no CRM/HighLevel mutation, no Supabase DDL/sync/backfill/row mutation, no Clio, no email/social/LinkedIn/ad action.
